name: guard-pack
description: Mod pack (function hooks, no daemon needed): keeps file tools inside this project's roots, redacts secret-shaped values in tool results before Claude sees them (the raw output may still be kept in the local transcript; see README Limits), routes production-deploy shell commands to the native ask dialog, and can hide agents of packs this project has not enabled. Reads policy from .claude/project.json at runtime; additive to core's shell hooks.

isolation.title: Project isolation
isolation.description: Deny file tools (Read, Edit, Write, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit, Glob, Grep) on paths outside this project's roots, and destructive Bash (rm, mv, cp, > redirects, cd) that names an absolute path outside them.

redaction.title: Secret redaction
redaction.description: Replace secret-shaped values in tool results with [REDACTED:<rule>] before Claude sees them. The raw output may still be kept in the local transcript (see README Limits).

prodGuard.title: Production-deploy guard
prodGuard.description: Send Bash commands that match a production-deploy pattern to the native ask dialog, whatever the permission mode.

agentOffer.title: Hide agents of disabled packs
agentOffer.description: Do not offer the model '<pack>:<agent>' agents whose *-pack is not enabled for this project (project.json enabledPacks or project/local settings enabledPlugins).

deferHeavyTools.title: Defer heavy MCP tools
deferHeavyTools.description: Put MCP tools whose description exceeds 2048 characters behind ToolSearch.

extraRoots.title: Extra roots
extraRoots.description: Comma-separated extra directories the isolation guard treats as inside this project (absolute, ~/..., or relative to the project root).
